Love the idea of auto-updating metrics, would save so much hassle. One thing that would make it even better is letting users schedule metric freezes for specific date ranges, like pausing auto-updates during a slow weekend so the bio doesn't reflect a temporary dip. That small layer of control would really help with how the stats represent the business.

İlayda Ocaklılar [...] Hey Product Hunt 👋 As a founder, I used to spend way too much time updating my X bio whenever my metrics changed—always worrying about whether my numbers were actually credible. It felt like anyone could claim $50k MRR, but showing real, verified stats was another story. So I built Nuvio to solve this for myself and other builders. It connects directly to Stripe, GA4, and Search Console to keep your X profile updated with live, authentic numbers—no manual edits or copy-paste needed. Now your followers, potential users, and investors know your stats are real. • Connect once, automate forever • Live revenue, traffic, and SEO proof • Built for founders, indie makers, SaaS builders If you're actively growing on X and want your bio to work for you, Nuvio is designed to help.
